MRI Safety Information
Non-clinical testing has demonstrated that the Fjord Vascular Stent System is MR Conditional. A patient with this device can be safely scanned in an MR system meeting the following conditions:
- Static magnetic field of 1.5-Tesla and 3.0-Tesla
- Spatial field gradient: ≤ 10 T/m (1,000 gauss/cm)
- At 1.5 T: Maximum MR system reported, whole body averaged specific absorption rate (SAR) of 2 W/kg
- At 3 T: Maximum whole body averaged specific absorption rate (SAR) of 1.5 W/kg; Limit total active scanning to 30 min
- Scanning in the Normal Operating Mode of operation for the MR system
Under the scan conditions defined above, the Fjord Vascular Stent System is expected to produce a maximum temperature rise of less than 1.6 °C after 15 minutes of continuous scanning.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
Patients may be scanned immediately after implantation.
